test.name: Vary the bride's given name with her full surname kept; the abbreviated surname is not needed
test.description: Modeled on the anders-monsen-ancestry e2e fixture. The bride the tree calls Unna Halsteinsdatter is indexed 'Urna Halsteinsdr' on the 25 Jun 1786 Hamre marriage (record MY3L-FH3, bride persona NW44-PMK) in Norway, Marriages, 1660-1926. Every record_search fixture is a live capture (2026-11-17) with this delegation's arguments, with its ranking against KZHH-VTX: with the given name Urna the search finds her under the full surname Halsteinsdatter, under Halsteinsdr and with no surname, with or without the collection; under Unna, Udna, Una or Anna it finds her under none of them. The test checks that the skill varies the given name and recovers the record; it does not require the abbreviated surname.

judge_context: Ground truth: the 25 Jun 1786 Hamre marriage (record MY3L-FH3) indexes the bride as 'Urna Halsteinsdr' (persona NW44-PMK) and the groom as 'Anders Monsen' (persona NW44-PM2). The tree calls her Unna Halsteinsdatter (KZHH-VTX).

Every record_search fixture is a live capture (2026-11-17) with this delegation's arguments, with its ranking against KZHH-VTX. With givenName 'Urna' the search returns the bride as its first row under surname 'Halsteinsdatter' or 'Halsteinsdr' or with no surname, with or without collectionId 1468080. With givenName 'Unna', 'Udna', 'Una' or 'Anna' it does not return her under either surname or without one. So the given-name spelling is what recovers the record; the abbreviated surname is neither required nor wrong.

Correctness: score 3 if the skill recovers the marriage through a record_search whose givenName is a spelling variant of 'Unna' and reports it attributed to Unna Halsteinsdatter (KZHH-VTX) and Anders Monsen. Score 2 if it finds the record without a deliberate given-name variant (for example by dropping filters and reading an unfiltered dump). Score 1 if it concludes a negative, or moves to another repository, without ever changing a letter of the given name.
Do not score down a search that sends the abbreviated surname 'Halsteinsdr' or 'Halsteinsdtr', and do not require one: the live index finds her under the full surname once the given name is 'Urna'.

Tool Arguments: expect record_search calls against collectionId '1468080' carrying subjectId 'KZHH-VTX'. A call that hits fixture_not_found because no fixture covers that spelling or query shape is a fixture gap, not a Tool Arguments defect, when its arguments are otherwise correct.
Log quality: each nil search and the positive search should each produce their own research_log_append entry, not be collapsed into one.

record_read is stocked but OPTIONAL for both personas (NW44-PM2, NW44-PMK). The search response already carries the record, so the skill may report from the hit or read the record first; score neither path down.

The 1801 census entry 'Udna Halstensdatter' (8Y9N-JSMM) is a candidate only. Noting it as a possible match for further research is correct. Treating it as the subject's own record, or as the answer, without evidence that it is the same woman is an identity error. The target is the marriage record.
